remarks: Modern Studio with Expansive Deck - Urban Edge Meets Coastal Charm  Bright and inviting, this stylish studio blends comfort, functionality, and an unbeatable location in the heart of South Norwalk. Step outside onto the oversized private deck-ideal for relaxing, dining al fresco, or unwinding under the stars.  Inside, enjoy pristine hardwood floors, and insulated windows that fill the space with natural light. A cozy nook accommodates a full-size bed, while the bathroom offers a full shower.  Additional features include an in-unit washer and dryer.  Conveniently located within walking distance to the train station, beach, movie theater, and SoNo's top restaurants, with easy access to major highways.  This studio is the perfect balance of coastal tranquility and city energy.
